card.name: The letter B starting B-words
card.fires_on: The single letter B (or a word just before one) that begins a word such as Bacterial, BUN, BID, BCG or Benicillin, usually in dosing or lab text. It sits at the start of a split-up word, right after words like and, or, as, Acute.

modes.label: B starting a medical term
modes.description: A lone B that starts a split word such as bacterial, BUN, BID or BCG.

modes.label: Stray ordinary word
modes.description: Occasional plain words like have or her in general prose.
modes.example: The adult frogs are totally land-based and don’t<< have>> webbed feet.

card.plain: It lights up when a word begins with a separate letter B, like the start of bacterial or BUN.
